title: FreightProspecting V1 — Frozen Lifecycle Qualification Gate

readiness_criteria.description: Physical facility address, city, state/province, and country in US or Canada confirmed by primary evidence.
readiness_criteria.code_logic: fac['physical_address'] present and not 'UNKNOWN', fac['city'] present, fac['state_prov'] present, fac['country'] in ('US', 'CA'), and facility has an accepted claim (is_current_accepted = 1) for 'physical_address' backed by at least one claim_evidence record with relationship = 'SUPPORTS'.

readiness_criteria.description: At least one facility commodity profile with approved FTL freight equipment category (Flatbed, Step Deck, or Dry Van).
readiness_criteria.code_logic: At least one row in facility_commodities for facility_id with equipment_category in ('FLATBED', 'STEP_DECK', 'DRY_VAN') and equipment_usage_status in ('VERIFIED', 'INFERRED'), AND an accepted claim for 'equipment_category' (verification_status in ('VERIFIED', 'INFERRED')) backed by claim_evidence with relationship = 'SUPPORTS'.

readiness_criteria.description: Eligible freight territory: Domestic US Lower 48 states or Canadian provinces/territories.
readiness_criteria.code_logic: If US: state_prov in LOWER_48_STATES (50 states minus HI and AK). HI is hard-excluded. AK is excluded by default in V1 (Decision A). If CA: state_prov in CANADIAN_JURISDICTIONS (10 provinces + 3 territories). Mexico (MX) is hard-excluded.

readiness_criteria.description: Phone-first, not phone-only. Valid callable phone route (10+ digits, non-placeholder) or usable email address with evidence provenance.
readiness_criteria.code_logic: At least one contact record for facility_id with valid phone (is_valid_phone_number) or valid email (is_valid_email), AND an accepted claim matching the contact's directness (phone_directness or email_directness/email_address) backed by claim_evidence with relationship = 'SUPPORTS'. If claim_notes contains phone digits, they must match the contact's current phone number.

readiness_criteria.description: Evidence provenance verified across facility, commodity, contact, or parent company claims.
readiness_criteria.code_logic: Facility has at least 1 accepted claim (is_current_accepted = 1) backed by linked evidence_sources via claim_evidence with relationship = 'SUPPORTS' referencing facility_id, facility_commodity_id, contact_id, or company_id.

facts_not_required_for_qualification: commercial_carrier_use is NOT required to be VERIFIED (UNKNOWN is completely valid and neutral).
broker_friendly_status is NOT required to be VERIFIED_ACCEPTS (UNKNOWN is completely valid and neutral).
private_fleet_present is NOT required to be VERIFIED (UNKNOWN is completely valid and neutral).
Named individual decision-maker contact is NOT required (a general facility or logistics department switchboard route satisfies usable_outreach_route).
Load availability, freight rate, or capacity postings are NOT required.
conditions_blocking_qualification: Missing physical facility address or address = 'UNKNOWN'.
Facility address not backed by an accepted claim with SUPPORTS evidence.
No commodity profile or commodity equipment category not in ('FLATBED', 'STEP_DECK', 'DRY_VAN').
Excluded commodity categories: Hazmat, precious cargo, live animals, raw fish/seafood, reefer/temperature-controlled primary targets.
Excluded geographic territories: Hawaii (HI), Mexico (MX), Alaska (AK unless override toggle enabled), overseas territories.
No callable telephone route (10+ digits) or usable email address.
Contact route not backed by an accepted directness claim with SUPPORTS evidence.
Active DO_NOT_CONTACT suppression at COMPANY or FACILITY scope.

lifecycle_transition_rule.rationale: Shortlisting indicates active campaign outreach prioritization and is operator-directed. Phase B research focuses strictly on factual qualification readiness (DISCOVERY -> QUALIFIED).
